protocol.prediction: baseline plus h/2 central per-sample derivative; maximize all 13 predicted rows for signed J, each metric and active sample
protocol.step_rationale: Young reuses the A4 R1 native probe: 0.1852% of baseline and well inside the frozen 2-15 MPa domain. Control is a 1 mN perturbation of an unsaturated 4.4-5.1 N channel; the existing knot interpolation distributes it over the final 50 ms. Chosen before any new rollout or held-out result, without tuning to its outcome.
protocol.policy_scope: A4 empirical accuracy policy plus explicit decision significance relative to R1 boundary margin; neither is a rigorous bound or a new task threshold. Inspect all 13 rows even if aggregate J improves. Active switches keep A4 max-gradient status unresolved; row-wise predictions and predicted classification are assessed separately.
protocol.freeze_order: commit protocol and driver; save training results and prospective predictions; commit predictions before calculating any holdout; then independent full MuJoCo playback and original evaluator
